candidates.reason: PR 7995 is a test-only fix for the open_in_browser ReDoS regression tests. Both test_open_in_browser_redos_comment and test_open_in_browser_redos_head build adversarial bodies ('-><!--\x00' repeated 25,000 times, and '<head\t' repeated 8,000 times) and assert that process_time() spent inside scrapy/utils/response.py:open_in_browser stays below MAX_CPU_TIME = 0.02, which flakes on slow interpreters. This is the only test file in the repository that imports process_time or contains ReDoS/redos coverage for open_in_browser, so it is the file the PR patch and any validation of the fix must target.
